title: Easiest-Ever Biscuits
steps: Heat the oven to 450°F and line a baking sheet with parchment. Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
Warm the cream to body temperature, then stir it into the dry mix until a soft, sticky dough forms.
Scoop the dough into rounds on the sheet, spaced well apart.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes, until the tops turn light golden. Brush with melted butter if you like.

title: Quick Green Chicken Chili
ingredients: 1 (2½-pound) rotisserie chicken, skin and bones discarded, meat shredded into bite-size pieces (3 cups)
steps: Soften the onion in oil with salt and pepper in a large pot, then add the garlic and cumin for a minute.
Add the broth, beans and green salsa, bring to a boil, then simmer about 10 minutes.
Mash some of the beans against the pot to thicken the chili.
Stir in the shredded chicken and cilantro and heat through.

title: Braised New Mexico–Style Pork in Red Chile Sauce (Carne Adovada)
ingredients: 1 (3½- to 4-pound) boneless pork butt roast, trimmed and cut into 1½-inch pieces
1 tablespoon plus 1 teaspoon kosher salt, divided
4 ounces dried New Mexico chiles, wiped clean, stemmed, seeded, and torn into 1-inch pieces
steps: Salt the pork pieces and chill them for an hour.
Soak the torn chiles in boiling water until soft, then blend them with some soaking liquid, the honey, vinegar, garlic and spices into a smooth sauce.
Coat the pork in the sauce in a Dutch oven, bring to a boil, cover and braise in a 325°F oven until very tender, about 2½ hours.
Stir the pork and sauce back together, let it stand a few minutes, and serve with lime wedges.

title: Roast Whole Turkey Breast with Gravy
ingredients: 2 teaspoons extra-virgin olive oil, plus extra as needed
steps: Cut the back off the turkey breast to use for gravy, rub butter, salt and pepper under and over the skin, and let it rest.
Roast at 325°F until the thickest part reaches about 130°F.
Meanwhile, brown the back with the vegetables, add water and herbs, and simmer into a quick stock.
Turn the oven to 500°F and roast until the skin is deep brown and the meat reaches 160°F, then rest it.
Make a roux with the pan fat and flour, whisk in the wine and stock, and simmer into gravy.

title: Fish and Chips
ingredients: 1 (2-pound) skinless cod fillet, about 1 inch thick
2 1/2 pounds large Yukon Gold potatoes, unpeeled
steps: Whisk the flour, cornstarch, salt and baking powder with the beer into a smooth batter, and chill it.
Cut the cod into eight pieces and the potatoes into thin planks, then into fries.
Start the fries in cold oil and cook until the oil boils and they turn golden, then drain.
Heat the oil to 375°F, dip the fish in batter and fry until deep golden, about 4 minutes a side.
Fry the potatoes once more briefly until crisp, and serve with lemon.

title: Grilled Jerk Chicken
ingredients: 3 pounds bone-in chicken pieces (split breasts cut in half crosswise, drumsticks, and/or thighs), trimmed
steps: Blend the scallions, oil, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, habanero, thyme, garlic and spices into a marinade, and set some aside.
Marinate the chicken for at least an hour.
Cook the chicken on the cooler side of a hot grill, covered, until nearly done.
Brush with the reserved marinade and char it skin side down over the hot side, then rest and serve with lime.

title: Hot and Sour Soup
ingredients: 3 tablespoons cornstarch, plus an additional 1 1/2 teaspoons
1 boneless, center-cut, pork loin chop (1/2 inch thick, about 6 ounces), trimmed of fat and cut into 1 inch by 1/8-inch matchsticks
3 tablespoons cold water, plus 1 additional teaspoon
1 cup bamboo shoots (from one 5-ounce can), sliced lengthwise into 1/8-inch-thick strips
4 ounces fresh shiitake mushrooms, stems removed, caps sliced 1/4 inch thick (about 1 cup)
5 tablespoons Chinese black vinegar or 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar plus 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar (see note below)
steps: Press the tofu, cut it into small cubes, and toss it with soy sauce and sesame oil. Coat the pork strips in soy sauce and a little cornstarch.
Simmer the bamboo shoots and mushrooms in the broth, then add the tofu and pork until cooked.
Thicken the soup with cornstarch slurry, then stir in the vinegar, chili oil and white pepper.
Drizzle in beaten egg in thin streams without stirring, let it set a minute, and top with scallions.

title: Faster Chinese-Style Barbecued Spareribs
ingredients: 1 (6-inch) piece fresh ginger, peeled and sliced thin
1/2 cup Chinese rice wine or dry sherry
5 - 6 pounds pork spareribs (2 racks, 2 1/2- to 3-pounds each), preferably St. Louis-style, cut into individual ribs
steps: Simmer the ribs with chopped ginger and garlic, honey, hoisin, soy sauce, rice wine, five-spice and white pepper until tender.
Lift out the ribs, strain the braising liquid and boil it with sesame oil into a thick glaze.
Toss the ribs in the glaze and roast them on a rack at 425°F, turning once, until lacquered and browned.

title: Marinated Velveted Chicken for Stir-Fry
ingredients: 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken breasts trimmed of excess fat and prepared according to illustrations 1 through 3
steps: Marinate thin strips of chicken breast in soy sauce, sherry and water for at least 20 minutes.
Drain well, then toss the chicken in a paste of sesame oil, cornstarch and flour so it is lightly coated and ready to stir-fry.

title: Easy No-Knead Focaccia
ingredients: 5 cups (625 g) all-purpose flour, preferably King Arthur brand
1 Tbsp. plus 2 tsp. Diamond Crystal or 1 Tbsp. Morton kosher salt
¼ cup plus 2 Tbsp. extra-virgin olive oil, divided, plus more for your hands
4 Tbsp. unsalted butter, plus more for pan
steps: Mix yeast, honey and lukewarm water, then add the flour and salt and stir into a shaggy dough.
Turn the dough in olive oil in a large bowl, cover, and let it rise in the fridge overnight.
Press it into a buttered and oiled pan, let it rise until puffy, then dimple it and sprinkle with flaky salt.
Bake at 450°F until golden, then brush with warm garlic butter and slice.

title: Shrimp Scampi Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb. peeled and deveined large shrimp (raw; 20–25 per lb.)
4 large garlic cloves, finely chopped or grated
½ tsp. crushed red pepper flakes
1 tsp. Diamond Crystal or ½ tsp. Morton kosher salt, plus more
½ tsp. freshly ground black pepper
½ cup chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley leaves
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Cook the shrimp quickly in olive oil, then add the garlic and pepper flakes, then the wine, salt and pepper, and simmer to reduce.
Cook the spaghetti until al dente, then toss it with the shrimp, butter, parsley and a splash of pasta water until glossy.

title: Creamy Lemon Pasta (Pasta al Limone, 15 Minutes)
ingredients: 12 oz. spaghetti or other long pasta
3 oz. finely grated Parmesan (about ¾ cup)
steps: Peel a few strips of lemon zest for garnish and finely grate the rest.
Cook the spaghetti in well-salted water until just short of al dente.
Warm the cream with the grated zest, then whisk in the butter.
Add pasta water and the spaghetti to the sauce, toss with Parmesan and lemon juice until creamy, and finish with pepper and the zest strips.

title: Make-Ahead Lentil Salad
ingredients: 1½ cups black beluga or French green lentils
½ tsp. crushed red pepper flakes
steps: Slice the kale thinly and massage it with salt and lemon.
Simmer the lentils in salted water until tender but still firm.
Gently fry the almonds, scallion whites, garlic, cumin and pepper flakes in olive oil, then strain, keeping the oil for dressing.
Toss the lentils with the kale, feta, smashed olives, the spiced oil and half the crunchy almond mix, and top with the rest.

title: Indian-Style Basmati Rice
steps: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear.
Toast the cumin, cardamom and cloves in butter, then stir in the rice until coated.
Add water, cinnamon, bay leaf and salt, bring to a boil, cover and cook on low about 17 minutes. Rest, covered, then fluff.

title: Classic Chicken Curry
ingredients: 1 jalapeño chile, stemmed, seeded, and minced
2 (10- to 12-ounce) bone-in split chicken breasts, trimmed
8 ounces Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch chunks
1/2 head cauliflower (1 pound), cored and cut into 1-inch florets
steps: Bloom the curry powder in butter, then soften the onions and jalapeño with salt and pepper. Add the garlic and ginger.
Add the chicken and water, cover and simmer until the chicken is cooked, then shred it.
Simmer the potatoes, then the cauliflower, in the curry until tender.
Stir in the peas, cilantro and shredded chicken, then the yogurt off the heat.

title: Tandoori Chicken
ingredients: 6 medium garlic cloves, minced or pressed through garlic press (about 2 tablespoons)
4 tablespoons juice from 2 limes, plus 1 lime, cut into wedges
3 pounds bone-in, skin-on chicken parts (breasts, thighs, and drumsticks, or a mix, with breasts cut in half), trimmed of excess fat and skin removed
steps: Cook the garlic and ginger in oil, then add the garam masala, cumin and chili powder.
Mix half the spice paste into the yogurt with lime juice; rub the rest, with salt and lime, into scored, skinless chicken.
Coat the chicken in the yogurt and bake at 325°F until almost cooked through.
Broil until charred in spots, and serve with lime wedges.

title: Lighthouse Inn Potatoes
ingredients: 4 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted, plus 6 tablespoons cut into 6 pieces
2 1/2 pounds russet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1-inch chunks
steps: Mix the Parmesan, panko and melted butter for the topping.
Simmer the potatoes in cream with baking soda, salt and pepper until tender.
Stir in the remaining cream and butter, spread it in a baking dish, and cover with the topping.
Bake at 375°F until bubbling and golden.

title: Burst Cherry Tomato Pasta
ingredients: 1 tsp. Diamond Crystal or ½ tsp. plus ⅛ tsp. Morton kosher salt, plus more for pasta pot
½ tsp. freshly ground black pepper
steps: Cook the pasta until al dente, keeping some of its water.
Warm the olive oil with the garlic, then add the cherry tomatoes, salt, pepper and a pinch of sugar, and cook until they burst into a sauce.
Toss the pasta with the sauce, loosen it with pasta water, and fold in the basil. Serve with Parmesan.

title: Sautéed Tilapia with Chive-Lemon Miso Butter
ingredients: 1 teaspoon grated lemon zest plus 2 teaspoon juice
steps: Salt the tilapia and let it sit 15 minutes.
Mash the miso with lemon zest and juice, pepper, softened butter and chives.
Split each fillet into a thick and a thin half and pat dry.
Sear the thick halves, then the thin halves, in very hot oil until golden. Top with the miso butter.

title: Stir-Fried Udon Noodles With Pork and Scallions
ingredients: 4 cups very coarsely chopped green cabbage (from about ¼ medium head)
2 7-ounce packages instant udon noodles, flavor packets discarded
5 scallions, white and pale-green parts coarsely chopped, dark-green parts thinly sliced
2 teaspoons finely grated fresh ginger (from a 1-inch knob)
1 tablespoon toasted sesame seeds, plus more for serving
steps: Brown the cabbage in a hot skillet and set it aside.
Loosen the udon in boiling water, drain and toss with sesame oil.
Brown the pork, add the scallion whites, ginger and pepper flakes, then the mirin and soy sauce.
Toss in the noodles, cabbage and sesame seeds, and top with the scallion greens.

title: Mezzi Rigatoni with Spicy Gochujang Tomato Sauce
ingredients: ½ teaspoon table salt, plus salt for cooking pasta
steps: Cook the pasta until al dente, keeping some water.
Soften the shallots and most of the garlic in butter, stir in the gochujang and tomato paste, then add the passata and cream and simmer.
Toast the panko in butter with the last of the garlic.
Toss the pasta with the sauce and some pasta water, and finish with the crumbs, chives and Parmesan.

title: Gochujang Chicken Tenderloins with Kimchi Coleslaw
ingredients: 1 cup cabbage kimchi, drained and chopped
steps: Toss the coleslaw mix with the kimchi, mayonnaise, a little sugar and salt.
Whisk the gochujang, soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic and remaining sugar into a glaze.
Sear the salted tenders in oil until browned and cooked through, then set aside.
Bubble the glaze in the pan, return the chicken and toss until glossy. Serve with the slaw.

title: Easy Fish Tacos
ingredients: ¼ cup lightly packed fresh cilantro leaves, chopped, plus more for garnish
1 jalapeño, stemmed, seeded if desired, and finely chopped
1 lb. flaky white fish fillets (such as mahi-mahi or cod), cut into 4 pieces
Crema mexicana, fresh salsa, hot sauce, and lime wedges for garnish
steps: Quick-pickle the sliced red onion in red wine vinegar.
Marinate the fish in olive oil, ancho, oregano, cumin, cilantro and jalapeño.
Cook the fish in a hot nonstick pan until it flakes.
Warm the tortillas and fill them with fish, pickled onion, crema, salsa and lime.

title: Hummus Bowls with Roasted Chicken and Cauliflower
ingredients: 1½ pounds boneless, skinless chicken thighs, trimmed
6 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil, divided, plus extra for drizzling
1¼ pounds cauliflower florets, cut into 2-inch pieces
½ English cucumber, cut into ½-inch dice
2 plum tomatoes, cut into ½-inch dice
steps: Toss the chicken with olive oil, baharat and salt, and the cauliflower separately with oil and salt, then broil both on a sheet until charred and cooked.
Dress the cabbage with lemon, salt and oil, and toss the cucumber and tomatoes together.
Spread hummus in bowls and top with the sliced chicken, cauliflower and salads, then mint and a drizzle of oil.

title: Pita Bread
ingredients: 2⅔ cups (14⅔ ounces/416 grams) King Arthur bread flour
steps: Mix the bread flour, yeast, ice water, oil and honey, then add the salt and knead until smooth and sticky.
Divide, shape into balls and let the dough rest in the fridge overnight.
Heat a baking stone at 425°F for an hour.
Roll each ball into a thin round and bake on the stone until it puffs, a few minutes. Keep warm under a towel.

title: Spiced Chicken Thighs with Dates and Carrots
ingredients: 1 pound carrots, peeled, quartered lengthwise, and cut into 3-inch pieces
steps: Season the chicken thighs with ras el hanout and salt, and brown them skin side down in an oven-safe skillet.
Toss the carrots and dates around the chicken, then roast at 450°F until the chicken is cooked.
Soften the shallot in a little of the fat, stir in the flour, then the broth, and reduce. Finish with lemon juice and butter, and spoon over the chicken.

title: Kuku Sabzi
ingredients: 1 medium leek, white and pale-green parts only, finely chopped
1½ tsp. Diamond Crystal or 1 tsp. Morton kosher salt
steps: Soften the onion and leek in oil and let them cool.
Whisk the eggs with salt, pepper, baking powder and turmeric, then fold in the herbs, fenugreek and the onion mix.
Pour into a hot oiled skillet, cook until the edges set, then finish under the broiler until puffed and set. Slice into wedges.

title: White Beans and Chorizo with Quick Marinated Tomatoes and Onion
ingredients: 3 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil plus ¼ cup extra-virgin olive oil, divided
⅛ teaspoon plus ½ teaspoon table salt, divided
6 ounces Spanish-style chorizo sausage, cut into ½-inch pieces
steps: Whisk sherry vinegar, a little oil, salt and pepper, and toss with the tomatoes and red onion to marinate.
Brown the chorizo in oil.
Add the beans, garlic, smoked paprika, salt and water and simmer until creamy. Stir in the parsley and top with the tomatoes.

title: Red Curry–Roasted Salmon and Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 2 pounds sweet potatoes, unpeeled, cut into ¾-inch-thick rounds
4 (6- to 8-ounce) skinless center-cut salmon fillets, 1 to 1½ inches thick
1½ tablespoons lime juice, plus lime wedges for serving
½ cup cilantro leaves, basil leaves, and/or thinly sliced scallions
steps: Toss the sweet potato rounds with oil, salt and pepper and roast at 450°F.
Fry some curry paste in oil, add most of the coconut milk with the sugar and fish sauce, and simmer into a sauce; finish with lime.
Brush the salmon with the rest of the curry paste and coconut milk, roast it beside the potatoes until just cooked, and serve with the sauce and herbs.

title: Panang Beef Curry
ingredients: 2 pounds boneless beef short ribs, trimmed
6 makrut lime leaves, middle vein removed, sliced thin
1/3 cup unsalted dry-roasted peanuts, chopped fine
steps: Slice the short ribs thinly and simmer them in water until tender.
Fry the curry paste in oil, then add the coconut milk, fish sauce, sugar, chile and the beef.
Simmer briskly until the sauce thickens and coats the beef. Top with lime leaves and peanuts.

title: Gà Kho Gừng (Vietnamese Caramel-Braised Chicken with Ginger)
steps: Cut most of the ginger into matchsticks and smash the rest; slice the shallot and garlic.
Trim the chicken thighs.
Cook the sugar and oil to a dark caramel, then add the ginger mix, then the chicken, and turn to coat.
Add the coconut water and fish sauce and simmer until the chicken is tender and the sauce reduces. Top with cilantro.

title: Tofu Banh Mi
ingredients: 14 ounces firm tofu, sliced crosswise into ½-inch-thick slabs
1/2 cucumber, peeled, halved lengthwise, seeded, and sliced thin
1 teaspoon grated lime zest plus 1 tablespoon juice
4 (8-inch) Italian sub roll, split lengthwise and toasted
steps: Drain and pat the tofu dry, season it, and coat in cornstarch.
Quick-pickle the carrot and cucumber with lime juice and fish sauce substitute; mix the mayonnaise with sriracha and lime zest.
Fry the tofu in hot oil until crisp on both sides.
Spread the toasted rolls with spicy mayo and fill with tofu, pickles and cilantro.

title: Jollof-Inspired Fonio
ingredients: 1 red onion (½ onion quartered, ½ onion sliced thin)
steps: Blend some broth with the tomatoes, part of the onion, the garlic, salt, sugar and pepper flakes.
Cook the tomato mixture in oil until thick and darker.
Stir in the fonio, bay leaves and remaining broth, cook until absorbed, then cover and let it stand off the heat.
Caramelize the sliced onion in oil, then fluff the fonio with butter and top with the onions and parsley.

title: Creamy Mushroom Pasta
ingredients: 1 lb. mixed mushrooms (such as maitake, oyster, crimini, and/or shiitake), torn into bite-size pieces
Zest and juice of ½ lemon
½ oz. Parmesan, finely grated (about ½ cup), plus more for serving
2 Tbsp. unsalted butter, cut into pieces
steps: Cook the pasta until very al dente, keeping some water.
Brown the mushrooms in olive oil in batches, then soften the shallots with them.
Add the pasta, cream and pasta water and toss over the heat until the sauce clings.
Off the heat, stir in lemon, Parmesan, parsley and butter, and season with pepper.

title: Curried Lentil Soup With Coconut and Tomatoes
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. virgin coconut oil or extra-virgin olive oil
1 (2½") piece fresh ginger, peeled, finely grated
¼ tsp. crushed red pepper flakes
½ cup finely chopped cilantro, plus leaves with tender stems for serving
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
1 (13.5-oz.) can unsweetened coconut milk, shaken well
steps: Soften the onion, garlic and ginger in coconut oil, then add the curry powder and pepper flakes.
Add the lentils, tomatoes, cilantro and most of the coconut milk with water, and simmer until the lentils break down.
Season, ladle into bowls and drizzle with the rest of the coconut milk. Serve with lime.

title: Vegetarian Black Bean Chili
ingredients: 2 medium red bell peppers, chopped (about 1⅔ cups)
3 15-oz. cans black beans, drained, ½ cup liquid reserved
Grated Monterey Jack, sour cream, chopped cilantro, and chopped scallions (for serving, optional)
steps: Cook the garlic, onions and peppers in olive oil, then stir in the chili powder, oregano, cumin and cayenne.
Add the black beans, some of their liquid and the tomato sauce, and simmer until thick.
Season and serve with cheese, sour cream, cilantro and scallions.

title: Vegan Chickpea Noodle Soup
ingredients: 3 carrots, peeled and sliced ¼ inch thick
2 celery ribs, sliced ¼ inch thick
2 teaspoons minced fresh thyme or ¾ teaspoon dried
steps: Soften the onion, carrots and celery in oil, then add the nutritional yeast, thyme and bay leaves.
Add the broth and chickpeas and simmer until the vegetables are tender.
Boil the ditalini in the soup until just tender, then stir in the parsley and season.

title: Classic Hummus
steps: Mix the water and lemon juice, and separately the tahini and olive oil.
Grind the chickpeas, garlic, salt, cumin and cayenne in a food processor.
With the machine running, add the lemon water, then the tahini mixture, and blend until smooth.
Let it sit 30 minutes before serving.

title: Sweet Potato Salad with Cumin, Smoked Paprika, and Almonds
ingredients: 3 pounds sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into ¾-inch pieces
3 tablespoons plus ¼ cup extra-virgin olive oil, divided
1 jalapeño chile, stemmed, seeded, and minced
1/2 cup fresh cilantro leaves and stems, chopped coarse
1/2 cup whole almonds, toasted and chopped
steps: Toss the sweet potatoes with oil and salt and roast at 450°F until browned and tender.
Whisk the scallions, lime juice, jalapeño, spices, garlic and olive oil into a dressing.
Toss the warm potatoes with the dressing, cilantro and toasted almonds.

title: Upside-Down Tomato Tart
ingredients: 2 pounds plum tomatoes (about 10), cored, halved lengthwise, seeds and gel removed
1 sheet puff pastry, thawed but still cool
steps: Simmer the sherry vinegar with sugar, salt, pepper, shallot, butter and thyme into a syrup in an oven-safe skillet.
Toss the halved tomatoes in the syrup and arrange them cut side up.
Cover with a round of puff pastry and bake at 400°F until the pastry is puffed and deep golden.
Cool a few minutes, then invert onto a plate.

title: Pasta e Fagioli for Two
ingredients: 1 tablespoon extra-virgin olive oil, plus extra for drizzling
¼ cup grated Parmesan cheese, plus extra for serving
¼ cup finely chopped fresh basil
steps: Cook the onion, carrot and pancetta in oil until soft.
Add the tomato paste, garlic and pepper flakes, then the broth and beans with their liquid, and simmer.
Boil the ditalini in the soup until al dente, then stir in the Parmesan and basil.

title: Butternut Squash Soup
ingredients: 2 Tbsp. vegetable oil, plus more for greasing
2 butternut squash (about 4¾ lb. total), halved lengthwise, seeds removed
2 cups thinly sliced white or yellow onion
5 cups (or more) low-sodium chicken broth or vegetable broth
Kosher salt, freshly ground black pepper
steps: Roast the halved squash at 375°F until soft, then scoop out the flesh.
Soften the onion with brown sugar, ginger, garlic and cinnamon in oil.
Add the squash and broth and simmer, then remove the cinnamon and purée until smooth.
Season and top with parsley.

title: BA’s Best Chocolate Chip Cookies
ingredients: 1½ cups plus 1 Tbsp. (200 g) all-purpose flour (spooning into measuring cups, then leveling)
1¼ tsp. (4 g) Diamond Crystal or ¾ tsp. (4 g) Morton kosher salt
¾ cup (1½ sticks; 169 g) unsalted butter, divided
6 oz. (170 g) bittersweet chocolate (60%–70% cacao), coarsely chopped, or semisweet chocolate chips
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F and whisk the flour, salt and baking soda.
Brown part of the butter, then melt in the rest and whisk in both sugars.
Beat in the egg, yolks and vanilla, then fold in the dry mix and chocolate.
Scoop onto lined sheets and bake until golden at the edges but soft in the middle.

title: Olive Oil Cake
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups (8 3/4 ounces/248 grams) plus 2 tablespoons sugar
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and grease a springform pan. Whisk the flour, baking powder and salt.
Whip the eggs until foamy, then add the sugar and lemon zest and whip until thick and pale.
Slowly stream in the olive oil, then fold in the dry mix alternately with the milk.
Pour into the pan, sprinkle with sugar, and bake until golden and set.

title: Basque Cheesecake
ingredients: 1 tsp. Diamond Crystal or ½ tsp. Morton kosher salt
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F and line a buttered springform pan with parchment that stands above the rim.
Beat the cream cheese and sugar until smooth, then add the eggs one at a time.
Mix in the cream, salt and vanilla, then sift in the flour and stir just to combine.
Bake until deeply browned on top and still very wobbly in the middle. Cool completely before slicing.

title: Chocolate Chip Banana Bread With Walnuts
ingredients: 1 tsp. Diamond Crystal or ½ tsp. Morton kosher salt
½ cup (1 stick) unsalted butter, room temperature
1 cup mashed ripe bananas (from about 2 large bananas)
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and grease a loaf pan.
Whisk the flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt, and toss in the chocolate chips and walnuts.
Beat the butter and sugar, add the eggs, then the banana, lemon juice and vanilla, and fold in the dry mix.
Bake about an hour, until a toothpick comes out clean, and cool before slicing.

title: Flourless Chocolate Cake
ingredients: 8 Tbsp. (1 stick) unsalted butter, plus more for pan
½ cup (4 oz.) fine-quality bittersweet chocolate, chopped
½ cup (42 g) unsweetened cocoa powder (not Dutch-process) plus more for garnish
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F and butter and line an 8-inch cake pan.
Melt the chocolate and butter together.
Whisk in the sugar, then the eggs, then sift in the cocoa and whisk until smooth.
Bake until the top forms a thin crust, cool, and dust with more cocoa.

title: Torta Caprese
ingredients: 171 grams (12 tablespoons) unsalted butter, cut into 12 pieces
steps: Heat the oven to 325°F and grease a springform pan. Melt the butter and chocolate with the vanilla.
Whip the egg whites with half the sugar to soft peaks.
Whip the yolks with the rest of the sugar until thick, then mix in the chocolate, almond flour, cocoa and salt.
Fold in the whites and bake about 50 minutes, until a toothpick shows a few moist crumbs. Cool and dust with powdered sugar.

title: Cottage Cheese Pancakes
ingredients: ⅔ cup (3⅔ ounces/104 grams) whole-wheat flour
1 cup (3 ounces/85 grams) old-fashioned rolled oats
steps: Whisk the flour and baking powder. Blend the cottage cheese, oats, eggs, melted butter, sugar, vanilla and salt until smooth.
Stir the wet mix into the dry just until combined.
Cook scoops of batter in a lightly oiled skillet over medium heat until golden on both sides.
Serve with jam, yogurt or fruit.

title: Cream Scones
ingredients: 2 cups (10 ounces/283 grams) unbleached all-purpose flour
5 tablespoons unsalted butter, chilled and cut into 1/4-inch pieces
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Mix the flour, baking powder, sugar and salt, then cut in the cold butter until it looks like coarse crumbs. Stir in the currants.
Stir in the cream until a dough forms, then knead briefly and pat into a round.
Cut into wedges and bake 12 to 15 minutes, until lightly browned.
